set.body:
PURPOSE

Move the mockup review record and its 29 baseline artifact hashes from session-owned /private scratch storage into durable StoryAtlas package custody. A /private path is neither durable evidence nor a privacy control, and it must not be the sole location behind a repair or review claim.

COORDINATION BOUNDARY

mockups/v2 currently has an active writer. Before touching files, identify the owning session and reserve a new, non-overlapping repository evidence path in Mote. Do not overwrite, rename, delete, or reinterpret the active writer's files. This bead authorizes a checksum-verified copy into repository custody, not destructive cleanup of the scratch source.

ACCEPTANCE

- Resolve the exact scratch source paths read-only and inventory every artifact with filename, byte size, modification time, SHA-256, capture dimensions, DPR, and generating/review tool where known.
- Preserve the complete review, its semantic-versus-craft taxonomy, PROOF-BOUNDARY relationship, and all 29 baseline hashes in a repository-owned evidence directory adjacent to the mockup package or in another documented package-owned path.
- Copy rather than move. Verify every destination hash against the recorded source hash before treating custody as transferred; leave scratch sources untouched until the repository candidate is independently verified.
- Record that DPR 1 images are historical defect baselines only. All post-repair visual judgments and hashes use DPR 2 or higher and live in a separate immutable repair set; repaired captures never overwrite baselines.
- Include a manifest that distinguishes source artifacts, generated captures, review prose, and hashes; it records missing inputs honestly and contains no raw participant data, secrets, or machine-specific credentials.
- Stage only the evidence slice, preserve unrelated work, and produce a reviewable candidate/commit with exact local and remote SHA evidence before claiming durable custody.
- If any scratch artifact has expired, do not recreate or guess its hash; record the missing item and recapture only under a new provenance identity.

DEPENDENCY EFFECT

The mockup successor may continue vocabulary and code-independent design work, but it cannot claim a repaired visual baseline or final pixel gate until this custody transfer and the DPR 2 capture prerequisite are satisfied.
set.title: Promote baseline review evidence out of /private scratch storage
